cases.title: POST /rooms with maxPlayers=2 as player-a returns HTTP 201
preconditions: The service under test exposes POST /rooms accepting a JSON body {maxPlayers, mode, ranked}.
The request is issued under the fixed identity player-a with mode=duel and ranked=false.
A fresh, independent room fixture is established for this test before the request is issued (per-test fixture reset).
steps: Send POST /rooms with JSON body {"maxPlayers": 2, "mode": "duel", "ranked": false} under identity player-a.
cases.expected: The service responds to the request with HTTP status 201; per the declared oracle only the HTTP status code is verified.
assertions: The observed HTTP response status code equals 201.

cases.title: Room creation with invalid capacity maxPlayers=9 returns HTTP 400
preconditions: The target service is reachable at the base URL provided via BLACKBOX_BASE_URL.
The caller identity for the request is player-a (fixed precondition shared by all in-scope requests).
The fixed request inputs are mode=duel and ranked=false (fixed preconditions shared by all in-scope requests).
The framework provides a fresh, independent game fixture for this test via its per-test reset.
steps: Using identity player-a, submit POST /rooms with JSON body {"maxPlayers": 9, "mode": "duel", "ranked": false}.
Observe the HTTP status code of the response.
cases.expected: POST /rooms with a JSON body containing maxPlayers=9, mode=duel and ranked=false, issued under identity player-a, responds with HTTP status 400.
assertions: Only the HTTP status code is asserted; no response body fields are asserted.
